components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary registration-vermilion pressroom trigger for Import Model, Export pill, Export to PDF, Save, and Done.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #c9341b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #b02b14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #c9341b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Archival Button
components.description: Archival paper secondary button framed by a crisp mineral hairline for sample loads and sheet actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeada4); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--card, #faf9f6); color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e2e1da); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #c9341b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--primary, #c9341b); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Floating Studio Pills
components.description: Opaque archival-paper floating perimeter pills with desktop-only identity pill (hidden on mobile), Style pill, and vermilion Export pill.
components.css: .ds-pills-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-pill, .ds-pill-circle { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeada4); background: var(--card, #faf9f6); color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); box-shadow: var(--shadow-surface); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill { padding: 0 14px; } .ds-pill-circle { width: 40px; } .ds-pill:hover, .ds-pill-circle:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e2e1da); } .ds-pill-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: var(--primary, #c9341b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); box-shadow: var(--shadow-surface); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #b02b14); }

components.name: Floating Mode Pill
components.description: Opaque floating bottom mode pill switching between Pan, Select, Rotate, and Arrange with vermilion active fill.
components.css: .ds-mode-track { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeada4); background: var(--card, #faf9f6); box-shadow: var(--shadow-surface); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-mode-item { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #56544d); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-mode-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); background: var(--surface-hover, #e2e1da); } .ds-mode-active, .ds-mode-active:hover { background: var(--primary, #c9341b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); }

components.name: Floating Page & Zoom Pill
components.description: Combined floating archival-paper pager and tabular-monospace zoom stepper pill at bottom center.
components.css: .ds-folio-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeada4); background: var(--card, #faf9f6); box-shadow: var(--shadow-surface); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-step-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e2e1da); } .ds-step-next { background: var(--primary, #c9341b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); } .ds-folio-div { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: var(--border, #c9c8c0); margin: 0 2px; } .ds-folio-readout, .ds-zoom-readout { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-folio-mono, .ds-zoom-readout { font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Archival Text Field
components.description: Sunken pressroom text and search input with vermilion caret and crisp border shift on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground, #56544d); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #c9c8c0); background: var(--surface-sunken, #ecebe5); color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); caret-color: var(--primary, #c9341b); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #c9341b); }

components.name: Welcome Proofing Sheet
components.description: Architectural archival-paper welcome sheet seated on mineral stone with calibration strip, flat hairline bands, and zero nested cards.
components.html:
Proofing Table.io · .ldr · .mpd

Set a brick model for print.

Every camera angle, callout, and page break stays bound to its step—so early edits never scramble downstream pages.

Drop a .io, .ldr, or .mpd file anywhere on this sheet.
components.css: .ds-proof-sheet { max-width: 460px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeada4); background: var(--card, #faf9f6); color: var(--foreground, #1b1a18); box-shadow: var(--shadow-page, 0 14px 34px rgba(27, 26, 24, 0.16), 0 2px 6px rgba(27, 26, 24, 0.08)); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-proof-strip { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #c9c8c0); background: var(--surface-sunken, #ecebe5); font-size: 12px; } .ds-proof-mono, .ds-proof-band code { font-family: var(--font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-proof-mono { color: var(--muted-foreground, #56544d); } .ds-proof-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-proof-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-proof-copy { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted-foreground, #56544d); } .ds-proof-band { padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, #aeada4); background: rgba(236, 235, 229, 0.45); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #56544d); }

components.css: .ds-ink-bar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); background: var(--ink-bar, #1b1a18); color: var(--ink-bar-foreground, #f4f2ec); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet, 0 16px 38px rgba(27, 26, 24, 0.16), 0 2px 6px rgba(27, 26, 24, 0.08)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Public Sans", sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-ink-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #c9341b); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-ink-action { padding: 4px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); color: var(--ink-bar-accent, #ff937d); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ink-action:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

narrative.overview:
Brick Instruction Works treats brick-model instruction authoring like a calibrated European print-proofing table. Opaque archival-paper floating pills (#FAF9F6 light / #23221F dark) edged with strong mineral hairlines float quietly above a calm mineral-stone proofing stage where either the welcome proofing sheet or the builder's live shadowed manual page sits as the undisputed hero. Every floating control, drawer, modal, and folio readout operates as an opaque pressroom instrument—quiet, tactile, hairline-separated, and legible on desktop monitors, tablets, and phones alike.

Because builders spend long sessions verifying piece visibility, camera angles, page breaks, and BOM layout on live instruction pages that carry their own bright LEGO brick colors and output themes, the studio chrome deliberately stays dry and achromatic outside a single registration-vermilion action accent. It rejects translucent frosted-glass blur, nested cards inside cards, generic blue CAD chrome, and decorative glow shadows in favor of solid archival paper pills and sheets, warm-mineral hairlines, and crisp mechanical transitions.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque archival floating pills: Crisp solid-paper pills (.studio-pill) with 1px --border-strong hairlines and neutral offset shadows float at top-left, top-right, and bottom-center so the manual page occupies the full viewport without glass blur. On mobile, the identity/title pill is hidden from the main canvas and lives inside the slide-out menu drawer.
Mineral-stone proofing table: Neutral stone ground (--background) gives bright archival manual sheets crisp physical contrast without beige warmth or cool blue cast.
Single-accent discipline: Registration vermilion (--primary) marks only primary actions, active selections, focus rings, and key indicators.

Self-hosted institutional typography: Variable Public Sans handles all prose and controls (>= 12px functional floor), paired with tabular JetBrains Mono strictly for folios, part IDs, file extensions, dimensions, and percentages.
Opaque hairline-separated sheets: Drawers, popovers, and modals use solid archival paper (--card) divided by 1px mineral rules (--border) rather than translucent glass or nested boxes.

rules.name: The One-Accent Pressroom Rule
rules.body: Registration vermilion (--primary) is the sole studio chrome accent. Never introduce secondary brand colors into floating pills, popovers, or drawers; keep brick and theme colors isolated inside the live manual page and theme preview swatches.

rules.name: The Neutral Mineral Ground Rule
rules.body: The proofing stage (--background) remains low-chroma mineral stone (#dcdfd9 light, #171614 dark)—never beige parchment and never cool blue-grey—so Warm, Classic Blue, Modern White, Collector Dark, and Blueprint manual pages all retain accurate color perception.

rules.name: The Mobile Clean-Canvas Rule
rules.body: On mobile (< 768px), omit the main-page title/identity pill (#desktopModelChip) so only compact floating controls appear over the canvas; the studio and active model title live cleanly inside the slide-out menu drawer.

rules.name: The 12px Functional Floor Rule
rules.body: Every interactive label, helper caption, badge, and monospace readout in studio chrome sits at >= 12px (0.75rem), with primary prose and body at 14px (0.875rem). Never drop studio UI labels to sub-12px micro-type.

rules.name: The Telemetry-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Reserve JetBrains Mono strictly for quantitative and machine-formatted data—folios, zoom scales, dimensions, counts, part codes, and file extensions—with tabular-nums enabled so live counters never jitter horizontally.

rules.name: The Opaque Pressroom Rule
rules.body: Studio chrome never uses backdrop-filter blur or translucent glass fills. Every floating pill, popover, drawer, and modal is solid archival paper or carbon ink backed by a 1px hairline border and neutral offset shadow.

rules.name: The Flat-Internal-Bands Rule
rules.body: Inside modals, drawers, and the welcome proofing sheet, separate sections with 1px --border hairlines and subtle --surface-sunken or --chrome band shifts—never stack bordered cards inside bordered cards.

dos: Do keep studio chrome strictly in the Billund mineral-stone, archival-paper, and carbon-ink palette, reserving registration vermilion (--primary) for primary actions, active selections, focus outlines, and key indicators.
Do use opaque .studio-pill archival-paper pills with 1px solid var(--border-strong) and neutral --shadow-surface for floating perimeter controls—never translucent frosted glass.
Do keep #desktopModelChip hidden on mobile (hidden md:inline-flex) so the main page stays title-free on narrow viewports.

Do use self-hosted Public Sans at >= 12px for all UI labels and 14px for body prose, and reserve tabular JetBrains Mono (.font-mono / .folio-num) strictly for folios, part IDs, file extensions, dimensions, counts, and percentages.
Do separate internal drawer, modal, and welcome-sheet sections using 1px solid var(--border) hairlines and subtle --surface-sunken / --chrome bands.
Do reveal popovers, drawers, and modal sheets with 180ms var(--ease-press) (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do keep all Export & Print modal actions full-document and center-aligned (Export to PDF, Export 3D Interactive Viewer (HTML), Print).
donts: Don't apply backdrop-filter glass blur, translucent pill fills, or colored accent drop-shadows anywhere in the studio interface.
Don't nest bordered cards inside bordered cards inside drawers, modals, or the welcome proofing sheet.
Don't introduce secondary brand hues (such as SaaS blue or purple) into studio controls or tint the mineral-stone proofing stage beige or blue-grey.
Don't apply .blueprint-grid to studio chrome—it exists exclusively as a user-selectable output theme inside the rendered manual page (#pageFrame).
Don't drop studio UI text below 12px or load external CDN fonts; keep all variable WOFF2 font faces self-hosted under src/assets/fonts/ for offline and static-host compliance.
